summary: This Form 6-K filed by DEFSEC Technologies Inc., a foreign private issuer, announces strong second-quarter fiscal 2026 results and product milestones. It details revenue growth of 68% year-over-year, an 81% increase in government program revenue, and the commercial launch of new products such as PARA SHOT ammunition and DEFSEC Lightning SaaS. The filing is a routine earnings and operational update. No transaction, strategic review, or special situation is disclosed. The registrant is providing periodic financial information as required under the 1934 Act. This is a standard current report of business updates, not a special-situation event.
